3,206,219.speech: Raid Marlhurst now; they are rich and weak enough; take their share, build wealth.

1,178,203.speech: Send raid on Oldbury; they have purse 124 and are 135 away, relatively strong but not overprotected, and my soldiers are sufficient (2 could march).

2,210,202.speech: Send raid on Brambridge; they are close, have 137 away, 100 purse, weak souls, and we have enough soldiers.
